new_all_degree_arguments: The inherited original left torus has weights(m,n,-n,-m,-r);SL2 ladders bound every depth-d ambient expression by max(n,m)*d.

eta^d times every ambient depth-d expression is exactly admissible and has all original weights <=-(min(n,m)-2)*d. The exponent and weight bound are sharp uniformly;all such phases are in the original nullcone with explicit all-marker cutoffs.
No nonzero ambient multiplier clears the entire algebra:the local conductor O[eta*s] subset O[s] is zero by leading-coefficient valuations.
Omega_Z=pullback(Omega_SL2)/eta is a nowhere vanishing canonical form,units are constant,and its normalized period T is the odd-coefficient Haar functional. The T(ab) pairing is nondegenerate.
All algebra automorphisms scale T. Nondegeneracy implies preservation of L=T(eta*-) iff eta is scaled;equivalently they preserve the branch divisor.

Generic eta-level base curves have genera3/4 by cyclic Riemann-Hurwitz. Since A1 has no nonconstant map to either curve,all Haar-preserving ambient automorphisms preserve B and normalize the free additive derivation by a constant.

Such automorphisms preserve every exact derivative-divisibility condition,so alpha(S)=S. They cannot repair any nonadmissible phase or marker. Universal clearing followed by any of them stays in the already safe automorphism saturation.
classical_inputs_proved_or_identified: SL2 ladder decomposition;regular conjugation and nondegenerate ordinary SU2 Haar pairing;Riemann-Hurwitz for degree-three cyclic covers;line-bundle tangent of an additive torsor. No automorphism-group or Makar-Limanov classification is imported.
exact_controls: Both defining gradings;mixed-parity depth3 clearing and extremal monomial;all20/40 highest-image terms have exact original positive weight;cyclic branch equations,squarefreeness,ramification orders and genera3/4;three nonzero Haar pairings;L=T(eta*-) in both quadratic algebras.
logical_boundaries: Universal filtration,canonical-volume,period and automorphism arguments remain internal written proofs,not machine verified by these controls.
Sharpness is uniform on the whole depth filtration;individual coefficient cancellations can need smaller branch exponents and are not classified.
Zero conductor is compatible with finite clearing on every depth filtration.
The automorphism theorem covers all algebraic automorphisms preserving L,not arbitrary rational transformations or general noninvertible maps.
No claim that every original quotient automorphism lifts to R,or that all admissible pure-null phases belong to an exhaustive safe normal form.
Both exceptional MZ decisions and the full original objective remain OPEN.
